payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each test case, iterates k from 2 to n-1, checks if n divisible by (2^k - 1), and outputs n // (2^k - 1) if so.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a naive linear search over possible k values, which is a form of complete search. Among the given subtypes, branch and bound is the closest despite the lack of pruning or bounds.
